title: 第21章 大战一触即发第22章 激战
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
“等会带着这个保护卷轴，上下同时扭转就能启动封存好的灵力屏障，还有带上你的龙纹印章和我下山。”
清晨，正准备吃饭的左丘辰便看到桌上有一个精致的密封卷轴，听到此话后，左丘辰心中一喜，卷轴这玩意可是好东西啊，特别是这种特制不需要灵力就能启动的卷轴。
看着眼前那洁白无瑕的脸颊，左丘辰也是微微微一笑，眼神变得更加灵动。
“看我干什么？本小姐美不胜收本人也知道，快吃饭。”
慕容仙儿无语道，心道你还以为今天院考开始，我带你下山去是为了试练的呢？
“好嘞。”
但是左丘辰不知道啊，他以为他以为的就是他以为的事，于是，端起碗筷准备饱餐一顿。
“等会要大战，你多吃点，万一死了也得做个饱死鬼。”
碗筷相碰的叮当声戛然而止，左丘辰一脸呆滞...
布满积雪的阶梯，左丘辰放慢脚步心中忐忑不安，这大个月虽然也听到些小道消息，什么北境要大乱，什么青圣降世，天道已死这些，虽然想过这些事情和夫子上道山，和青圣有关，但是他没想到事情会那么严重。
正午的太阳直射北宣学院，外院的广场巨大无比，容下数千人绰绰有余，密密麻麻奇形各异装扮的青年才俊汇聚到此地，都是充满希望的少男少女，都是黑马啊...
黑白分明的发色，一脸祥和的徐长老出现在平台之上看着众人，随后几位长老一一现身。
外院平台所处和内院只有一墙之隔，此刻慕容仙儿叫左丘辰老实待着内院别出来，因为等会有事情发生，遇到危险就拧开卷轴。
“咳咳，首先欢迎诸位，老夫徐天为北宣学院六长老，特在此地主持此次院考大典，来自各州的青年才俊，手持龙纹印章者拥有进入北宣学院的试练资格！”
“说来惭愧，老夫二十岁入院，百岁之龄踏过造化，三百岁才入三生境，我这修炼速度算是平庸，当然你们当中不乏天骄，在场之人已有数人进入了造化境，真是后生可畏啊。”
徐老说出此话后，广场众人都是左观右看，很难相信这些人中居然有造化境存在，但是一想到这几日的见闻，也不诧异。
众人也是把目光锁定到那大禹国姬家两人，还有那大齐的皇显，还有那书生少年，虽然听闻好似被人骗了，但是他确拿回了自己的龙纹印章，且其本人来自书州。
广场之上，众人四次观望，顿时不少人看到了那个劲装少年，顿时都是咬牙切齿。
“原来我这么受欢迎，嘿嘿。”
面对这样的局面，萧飞也是略显尴尬，早知道自己就易容了，看这些家伙压制不住的怒气，怕是等会自己会挨揍了。

当然最被注视的就是那力大无穷的胖子和那群藏在白袍下的人。
这么些时日，胖子的身份也被众人知晓，名为周宇，北蛮族后人，岐山周氏，这可是在九州大陆声名远赫的大族，只是众人纳闷为何此次北蛮族的人会来北安城参加一个落寞的北宣学院院考。
而那群白袍人引来的目光比岐山周氏更甚，因为那是雪国之人，极北之敌，自成一国，神秘之极，已有数千年没出现在世人眼中了。
虽说此次院考的学员不多，但是出现了几位特殊身份的人，不但让众人费解，就连北宣学院也是没有任何眉目。
“时辰已到，北宣学院院考正式开始，此次乃是试炼之地院考，规则在这场所两侧石壁上，无需多言，顺便提一句，此次院考当然选择淘汰制，故此北宣学院弟子只有五百名额，各位努力吧！”
广场众人惊愕，只有五百名额，虽然这也不少，但是却筛去了大半人啊，看上去不算很残酷，但是比试乃是试炼之地，那结果能剩下多少人就太悬乎了...
两侧石壁所示，十五日的试炼之地，所有人进入试炼之地后，可猎杀灵兽，破除阵法，夺取灵药灵石，简单来说就是凭实力赚取积分，低于五千分者视为淘汰，反之则通过考验。
“此为第一重试炼，开始吧”
听到徐老的话语，众人也是明了，原来试炼之地就是简化版的虚灵界，但是在场众人谁不知虚灵界威名，就算是简化版，那么也可以放开生死一搏。
广场内众人都是心中怀揣着希望静待试炼之地开启...
终于，激动人心的时刻到来了，场中众人心中兴奋，为了这一刻多少人背井离乡，多少人经历一路坎坷甚至九死一生才到这里。
当试炼之门打开的时候，平台一边的左丘辰看到了那一双双渴望强大渴望实力的眼神，少年微笑，真替这些人高兴，至少有能力去追逐自己的梦想，而自己只能想想...
“请诸位血祭龙纹印章，然后收好功勋简进入试炼之门。”
徐老的声音再次传来，于是乎场中少男少女皆是拿出龙纹印章，然后指尖一滴鲜血滴入。
content_en:
"Take this protection scroll with you later. Twist it up and down at the same time to activate the sealed spiritual barrier. Also, take your dragon seal and come down the mountain with me."
In the early morning, Zuo Qiuchen, who was preparing to eat, saw an exquisite sealed scroll on the table. After hearing this, Zuo Qiuchen was delighted. This scroll is a good thing, especially this kind of special scroll that can be activated without spiritual power.
Looking at the flawless white cheeks in front of him, Zuo Qiuchen also smiled slightly, his eyes becoming more alert.
"What are you looking at me for? I know this young lady is extremely beautiful. Hurry up and eat."
Murong Xian'er said speechlessly, thinking in her heart, you thought the college exams started today and I took you down the mountain just for the test?
"Okay."
But Zuo Qiuchen didn't know. He thought that what he thought was what he thought, so he picked up the bowl and chopsticks and prepared to have a full meal.
"There's going to be a big battle later. Eat more. If you die, you'll be a starved person."
The clinking sound of bowls and chopsticks suddenly stopped, Zuo Qiuchen looked dull...
On the snow-covered stairs, Zuo Qiuchen slowed down and felt uneasy. Although he had heard some rumors in the past month, about the chaos in the north, about the coming of the Qing Sage, the death of Heavenly Dao, etc. Although he had thought about these things being related to the master going to Dao Mountain and the Qing Sage, he did not expect that the matter would be so serious.
The midday sun shines directly on the Bei Propaganda College. The square in the outer courtyard is huge, more than enough to accommodate thousands of people. Thousands of young talents in various shapes and costumes gather here, all young boys and girls full of hope, all dark horses...
Elder Xu, who had black and white hair and a peaceful face, appeared on the platform and looked at everyone, and then several elders appeared one by one.
There was only a wall between the platform of the outer courtyard and the inner courtyard. At this moment, Murong Xianer told Zuo Qiuchen to stay in the inner courtyard and leave, because he would unscrew the scroll if something happened and he was in danger.
"Ahem, first of all, welcome everyone. I, Xu Tian, is the sixth elder of Beixuan College. I am specially here to preside over this college examination ceremony. Young talents from various states who hold the dragon seal have the qualifications to enter Beixuan College!"
"I feel ashamed to say that I was admitted to the hospital at the age of twenty, passed through the realm of creation at the age of a hundred, and only entered the realm of the third life at the age of three hundred. My cultivation speed is considered mediocre. Of course, there are many geniuses among you. Several people present have already entered the realm of creation. It is really a formidable future."
After Mr. Xu said this, everyone in the square looked left and right. It was hard to believe that there were people in the Creation Realm among these people, but when they thought about what they had seen and heard in the past few days, they were not surprised.
Everyone also focused on the two people from the Ji family of Dayu, as well as the emperor of Daqi, and the young scholar. Although they heard that he seemed to have been deceived, he did get his dragon seal back, and he was from Shuzhou.
On the square, everyone looked around for four times. Suddenly, many people saw the handsomely dressed young man and gritted their teeth.
"So I'm so popular, hehe."
Faced with such a situation, Xiao Fei also felt a little embarrassed. If he had known that he would be embarrassed, looking at the uncontrollable anger of these guys, he was afraid that he would be beaten later.
Of course, the ones that attracted the most attention were the powerful fat man and the group of people hiding under the white robes.
Over the past few days, Fatty's identity has become known to everyone. His name is Zhou Yu, a descendant of the Northern Barbarian tribe, and the Qishan Zhou family. This is a famous family in the Kyushu continent, but everyone is wondering why the Northern Barbarian tribe came to Bei'an City to take the exam of a lonely Beixuan Academy.
And those people in white robes attracted more attention than the Qishan Zhou family, because they were people from the Snow Country, the enemy in the far north, a country of their own, extremely mysterious, and had not appeared in the eyes of the world for thousands of years.
Although there were not many students in this college examination, the appearance of several people with special identities not only puzzled everyone, but even Beixuan College had no clue about it.
"The time has come, the college entrance examination of Bei Propaganda College has officially begun.This is the academy examination in the place of trial. The rules are on the stone walls on both sides of the place. Needless to say, by the way, of course, the elimination system is chosen for this examination. Therefore, there are only 500 places for Beixuan Academy disciples. Please work hard! "
Everyone in the square was shocked. There were only 500 places. Although this was a lot, most of them were screened out. It didn't look very cruel, but the competition was a place of trial. How many people would be left in the result was too uncertain...
As shown on the stone walls on both sides, on the 15th day of the trial, after everyone enters the trial, they can hunt spiritual beasts, break formations, and seize elixirs and spiritual stones. In simple terms, they earn points based on their strength. Those who score less than 5,000 points are considered eliminated, and those who fail to pass the test.
"This is the first trial, let's begin."
Hearing Mr. Xu's words, everyone understood that the trial place was a simplified version of the Void Spirit Realm, but everyone present did not know the power of the Void Spirit Realm. Even if it was a simplified version, it could still be a life-and-death struggle.
Everyone in the square is waiting with hope in their hearts for the trial place to open...
Finally, the exciting moment has arrived, and everyone in the venue is excited. For this moment, many people have left their hometowns, and many people have gone through ups and downs and even narrowly escaped death to get here.
When the door of the trial opened, Zuo Qiuchen on the side of the platform saw the eyes that longed for power and strength. The young man smiled. He was really happy for these people. At least they had the ability to chase their dreams, but he could only think about...
"Please make a blood sacrifice to the Dragon Seal, then collect the Merit Slip and enter the Trial Gate. "
Elder Xu's voice came again, so all the boys and girls in the field took out dragon seals, and then dripped a drop of blood from their fingertips.
